---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for Coco
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Feature Description
Describe the feature you'd like to see. What problem would it solve?

## Use Case
Who would benefit from this feature? What's the real-world scenario where this would be useful?

Example:
- As a [user role], I want to [action] so that [benefit]
- Officers need a way to quickly export member data for reporting

## Proposed Solution
Describe how this feature should work. Include:
- What would users see?
- What would they interact with?
- What would the result be?

## Alternative Solutions
Have you considered other ways to solve this problem? Describe any alternatives you've thought of.

## Additional Context
Any other information that helps explain the feature request? Feel free to include:
- Screenshots of similar features in other tools
- Links to design mockups
- Relevant discussions or decisions

## Priority
- [ ] Low – Nice to have, not urgent
- [ ] Medium – Would improve the platform
- [ ] High – Blocks workflow or is critical

## Related Issues
Is this related to any other issues or discussions? Reference them here (e.g., #123).

---

**Note:** Feature requests help us prioritize what to work on next. Thank you for helping us improve Coco!
